comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: In a storm, fishing skill can be used (consumes vigour) but no fish will be caught until the storm ends

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Eh, also turns out that if you trigger a siren disaster effect while sailing, your fishing skill will use up vigor but yield no fish. It happened to me when I was charting the Canary Sea, and had nothing handy to help banish the silly siren singing. No fishies were caught by my active fishing skill until the singing finally stopped about two minutes later.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: The same thing also happens if your fishing when there's a storm happening. Needless to say, it pays to always carry around Cotton Earplugs or, a better choice, a musical instrument like a Violin
